subject: Re: Kickoff: latent subgroup shift adaptation for platform models
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing:

Staffing: Kaia 50% as method lead (she'll take the discrete eigendecomposition path first — it's the most interpretable and the easiest to defend in an incident review), Freya 40% on the historical-incident study design, Quentin 40% running the replication notebooks and the shift-strength sweeps, Giannis 30% packaging the library — the pip-installable structure of the release makes that straightforward.

Compute this window: light. The synthetic experiments and the incident study run on a handful of Titan A100s.

Q3 budget, per your ask: conversation with finance is done. Idris has verbally earmarked $180k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-57 for our production-scale validation runs — I'm treating that line as committed to us. Idris, cc'd so we have this in writing; formal request follows the Jun 24 readout, but the number is sized to Freya's validation plan (three model families, six months of replayed traffic each).

Santiago
